terra.problem: Saying David is not bragging assigns him an attitude the text does not give.
Saying God is the message changes David's point. He says the Spirit spoke through him and God's word was on his tongue.
Saying the grass has just had rain adds timing. The verse says after the rain, not how recently.
The explanation states as fact that David is feeling sure. His feeling should be marked as Papa Dorin's impression.
Papa Dorin says he would take an old age himself, but he does not have an age.
David being a warrior is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The text does not say nobody wants to touch the thorns. It says they cannot be gathered by hand.
The explanation is flat and repetitive: it makes essentially the same point about prickly thorns twice.
The text does not say cloth would be shredded. That is an asserted outcome rather than something the picture establishes.
The text does not say reeds would bend or snap if used on the thorns.
Saying the thorns are not hauled anywhere goes beyond the text. It says they burn where they lie, not whether they were moved beforehand.
Saying there was no long trip rules out earlier movement that the text does not address. It says the thorns burn where they lie.
